brief.t: START HERE: Ask Ron and Aaron for the Talova trial results and sanitation sign-off before today’s proposed filling.

ACT NOW 1: Talova: verify trial-to-fill readiness today. Michael’s October 29 plan proposed filling today, conditional on verified cleaning, successful trials and release. Results and the exact linked project/batch remain unconfirmed; 5,000 boxes need an assigned lead. Talova Face/Body Balm’s separate CRM completion date is 16 days past, not proof the trial is that project. Send internally: Ron and Aaron, please send yesterday’s Talova trial results and sanitation sign-off, confirm the batch and QC approval, and have Michael assign today’s filling and packing lead before we start.

ACT NOW 2: Men’s Moisturizer: reconcile today’s production date. Validation due October 26 is 4 days overdue. CRM still shows Sample Batching, no assignee and 0/7 pre-flight despite today’s production date. The 21-of-25 shortage banner and unlinked orders do not establish physical shortages or an approved run. Send internally: Michael and Evelyn, please confirm the sample approval and whether today’s Men’s Moisturizer run is real, then reconcile usable stock and linked incoming orders with me before scheduling it.

ACT NOW 3: Oreka: confirm finished-sample delivery before November 1. Nadia’s reply task is 16 days overdue. CRM still shows sample batching. Mibelle now says the ingredient shipped October 29, but ingredient tracking does not prove finished samples are QC-approved, shipped or able to arrive in Canada before November 1. Send internally: Michael and Steve, please confirm Oreka’s finished samples, QC release and a delivery plan before Nadia leaves Canada; if that window is no longer feasible, give me the revised plan today.
